Load AusTraits database into R console

Source: R/load_austraits.R
load_austraits.Rd

Finds the requested release of AusTraits on Zenodo and loads it with traits.use::load_database(), which downloads the relational database .rds to path (if it is not already there, or if the copy there does not match the release's md5 checksum) and loads it.

Usage

load_austraits(
  doi = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  path = "data/austraits",
  update = TRUE,
  means = FALSE
)

Arguments

doi

character string - doi of particular version

version

character string - version number of database, e.g. "7.0.0"

path

file path to where AusTraits will be downloaded

update

if TRUE, the list of AusTraits releases (see get_versions()) and the release's metadata are downloaded afresh; if that fails (e.g. offline), the copies saved in path are used. With FALSE, the saved copies are used without contacting Zenodo, so a release loaded before loads offline.

means

if TRUE, load the release's observed means rather than the database; traits.use::trait_means_dictionary() defines their columns. A release from before the means were published gives an error saying so.

Value

a large list containing AusTraits data tables, of class traits.build. Its sources have the class traits_build_sources (see ?traits.use::traits_build_sources), also for releases built before that class existed, so a reference can be looked up by key with $ as well as [[ and [, e.g. austraits$sources$Falster_2005. With means = TRUE, a tibble of the observed means.

Details

With means = TRUE it loads the release's observed means instead: one row per taxon and trait, computed from the release's records with traits.use::summarise_trait_means() and published with it as austraits-<version>-observed-means.rds and .csv.gz (releases after 7.0.0; the .rds, exact, is read when present). They are a smaller download than the database. To have both, load each.

See also

get_versions(), get_version_latest(), traits.use::load_database(), which loads any traits.build database from its doi

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
austraits <- load_austraits(version = "7.0.0", path = "data/austraits")

# The observed means of each taxon and trait, published with releases after 7.0.0
means <- load_austraits(version = "8.0.0", path = "data/austraits", means = TRUE)
} # }
